limited_dimension_probe.proof: For directed_max, pairs(a,b),(c,d) with positive fitted distances whose active maximum is the same coordinate obey F(a,b)+F(c,d)<=F(a,d)+F(c,b). Under uniform absolute label error epsilon, exact D(a,b)+D(c,d)-D(a,d)-D(c,b)<=4epsilon. A verified pairwise-positive-gap clique ofM pairs therefore needs at leastM active coordinates for exact fit, or forces uniform error>=minimum_gap/4 when dimension<M. Unreachable teacher labels use the declared240 proxy, exactly as the point loss. Only original allowed point/cross relations are used.
limited_dimension_probe.scope: Teacher-only finite label geometry. A witness below128 does not prove128D feasibility. A bound on worst absolute error is not a bound on average error or80 percent greedy completion. No encoder coordinate or new training label is supplied.
limited_dimension_probe.interpretation: Largest discovered incompatibility clique has27 pairs, below the current128 coordinates. This probe finds no128D lower-bound obstruction at the tested gaps; it does not establish representability or convergence and does not justify changing dimensionality by itself. Full training-goal distance profiles validate the witnesses only and are never model inputs or a trained solution.
